generic.title: This page did not load
generic.body: Something failed at our end while this page was being put together. Nothing you have done has been lost and nothing has been changed. Try once more, and if it still will not open, telephone the clinic.
generic.reachClinic: The clinic's telephone number is at the foot of every page.
generic.referenceLabel: If you telephone about this, read them this code
generic.referenceNote: It points our engineers at this one failure. It holds nothing about you and nothing about your care.

booking.title: The booking page did not load
booking.body: This page failed while it was being put together, so it cannot tell you whether a time was taken. Look at your appointments before you book again: a time that is yours will be listed there, and booking a second one would hold two.

payment.title: This page did not load
payment.body: The page failed before it could read anything, so nothing on this screen tells you what state this payment is in. Do not pay again on the strength of this page. Try once more, and if it still will not open, telephone the clinic and give them the code below.
